headHtml: <meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/><title>Official MD Store — NIGHT</title><meta content="NIGHT OFFICIAL MD STORE — NIGHT 공식 MD와 라이프스타일 컬렉션을 둘러보는 merchandise archive." name="description"/><link href="assets/css/style.css" rel="stylesheet"/><style>.store-page .store-modal{padding:28px 18px}.store-page .store-modal-panel{width:min(960px,calc(100vw - 36px));max-height:86vh;overflow:auto;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(320px,.95fr);gap:28px;padding:28px}.store-page .store-detail-gallery>img{width:100%;max-height:520px;object-fit:contain;background:#080810}.store-page .store-detail-thumbs{gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.store-page .store-detail-thumbs button{width:68px;height:68px}.store-page .store-detail-thumbs img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.store-page .store-detail-copy h2{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,36px);line-height:1.15}.store-page .store-detail-copy{align-self:start}@media(max-width:760px){.store-page .store-modal{padding:12px}.store-page .store-modal-panel{width:calc(100vw - 24px);max-height:92vh;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;padding:18px}.store-page .store-detail-gallery>img{max-height:42vh}.store-page .store-detail-thumbs button{width:54px;height:54px}.store-page .store-detail-copy h2{font-size:26px}}.store-page .store-extra-options{display:contents}</style>
